Title: APEXFISSION / CARD DESIGNER
Description: Standalone card designer website and API

Inputs.Name: DNSProvider
Inputs.Label: Public DNS provider
Inputs.Help: Choose AWS Route 53 or Cloudflare for your website's DNS. With the generated CloudFront URL, no DNS records are created.

Inputs.Name: Domain
Inputs.Label: Website hostname
Inputs.Help: Enter a full hostname, such as cards.example.com, or none for the generated CloudFront URL.

Inputs.Name: CertificateARN
Inputs.Label: CloudFront ACM certificate ARN
Inputs.Help: Use an ISSUED us-east-1 certificate for the hostname, or none with the generated URL.

Inputs.Name: ZoneID
Inputs.Label: DNS zone ID
Inputs.Help: Use the selected provider's existing zone ID (Route 53: Z..., Cloudflare: 32 hexadecimal characters), or none for manual DNS. Cloudflare-managed records also need a Cloudflare API token in Credentials.

ArtifactDescriptions.web: Stores the website files behind CloudFront origin access control.
ArtifactDescriptions.data: Stores private user designs and immutable portrait package cache.
ArtifactDescriptions.tokens: Stores hashed expiring and revocable read-only personal API tokens.
ArtifactDescriptions.login: Provides the Cognito hosted sign-in domain.
ArtifactDescriptions.api: Routes browser and renderer requests to the Go API.
ArtifactDescriptions.web-access: Allows only the CloudFront distribution to read website objects.
ArtifactDescriptions.worker-sandbox: Limits template worker capabilities with a Content Security Policy.
ArtifactDescriptions.site: Serves the website and API over HTTPS.
ArtifactDescriptions.browser: Provides the public Cognito PKCE authorization code client.
ArtifactDescriptions.api-role: Provides a dedicated execution identity for the API Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.api-logs: Retains API execution logs for 30 days.
ArtifactDescriptions.api-permissions: Limits Lambda access to its data paths, tokens and logs.
ArtifactDescriptions.handler: Runs the authenticated card designer API.
ArtifactDescriptions.lambda: Connects the HTTP API to the Lambda handler.
ArtifactDescriptions.api-routes: Routes API paths to the Lambda integration.
ArtifactDescriptions.gateway: Allows API Gateway to invoke the API Lambda.
ArtifactDescriptions.web-policy: Restricts website object reads to CloudFront and requires TLS.
ArtifactDescriptions.data-tls: Requires TLS for the private data bucket.
ArtifactDescriptions.site-dns: Points the custom website hostname to CloudFront.
ArtifactDescriptions.web-private: Blocks public access for the web bucket.
ArtifactDescriptions.web-encryption: Enables encryption at rest for the web bucket.
ArtifactDescriptions.web-versions: Enables versioned recovery for the web bucket.
ArtifactDescriptions.data-private: Blocks public access for the data bucket.
ArtifactDescriptions.data-encryption: Enables encryption at rest for the data bucket.
ArtifactDescriptions.data-versions: Enables versioned recovery for the data bucket.
